translations.web: Take that which is yours, and go your way. It is my desire to give to this last just as much as to you.
translations.bsb: Take your pay and go. I want to give this last man the same as I gave you.
translations.kjv: Take that thine is, and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.
translations.asv: Take up that which is thine, and go thy way; it is my will to give unto this last, even as unto thee.
